pages.text: Addons are chips that $(l)improve a drone$(). Put them in the four $(l)addon slots$() of the $(l:drone_systems/drone_assembler)Drone Assembler$(/l): each slot holds a stack of the same addon.$(br2)How many addons fit depends on the $(l:drone_systems/drone_frames)frame$(/l):

$(li)$(l)Basic Drone Frame$(): 4$(br)$(li)$(l)Advanced Drone Frame$(): 8$(br)$(li)$(l)Elite Drone Frame$(): 16$(br)$(li)$(l)Mini Drone Frame$(): 2$(br)$(li)$(item)Speed Addon$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Stack Addon$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Battery Addon$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Fortune Addon$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Silk Touch Addon$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Anchor Addon$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Efficiency Addon$()

$(li)$(l)Speed Addon$(): +10% flight speed each, frame limit only, +10% flight cost$(br)$(li)$(l)Stack Addon$(): +1 stack (64 items) per $(l:drone_systems/modules)Transport$(/l) trip each, up to 9 stacks per trip, +5% flight cost$(br)$(li)$(l)Battery Addon$(): +25% of the frame's battery capacity each, frame limit only, +5% flight cost

$(li)$(l)Fortune Addon$(): +1 Fortune level for Quarry and Harvester drops, max 3, +25% energy per job$(br)$(li)$(l)Silk Touch Addon$(): Silk Touch for Quarry and Harvester drops, max 1, +50% energy per job

$(li)$(l)Anchor Addon$(): Its dock keeps the drone's chunks loaded, max 1, 4 FE/t per chunk, from the dock$(br)$(li)$(l)Efficiency Addon$(): Saves power in flight and on every job, max 3, -10% flight cost and -10% energy per job each

$(l)Fortune and Silk Touch cannot be combined$(), just like the enchantments.$(br2)Without Stack Addons a Transport drone carries only $(l)16 items$() per trip.$(br2)The percentages add up: see how the total is worked out on the $(l:drone_systems/drones)Using Drones$(/l) page.

A drone only works while its chunks are loaded: walk away from a far dock and it stops. With an $(l)Anchor Addon$() its $(l:drone_systems/drone_dock)Drone Dock$(/l) keeps loaded:$(br)$(li)the dock's own chunk;$(br)$(li)the chunks around the drone, following it as it flies;$(br)$(li)the two ends of its transport route;
pages.title: Anchor Addon

pages.text: $(li)its work area.$(br)That is up to $(l)25 chunks$() per dock. The dock pays $(l)4 FE/t for each chunk$() out of its battery: when the battery runs dry, or the dock is paused, it lets the chunks go. It also works on a Builder Swarm Dock, for its anchored Mini Drones. Server owners can change the cost and the
number of chunks, or switch anchoring off, in the drones section of the CyberFarm config.

The Speed, Efficiency and Battery Addons also fit ten machines: the $(l:generators/biomass_press)Biomass Press$(/l), $(l:generators/bio_digester)Bio-Digester$(/l), $(l:generators/acid_synthesizer)Acid Synthesizer$(/l), $(l:nuclear/coolant_mixer)Coolant Mixer$(/l), $(l:materials/aluminum)Electrolyzer$(/l), $(l:materials/carbon_fiber)Pyrolysis Oven$(/l), $(l:materials/circuits)Fabricator$(/l), $(l:mech/mech_core)Crystallizer$(/l), $(l:nuclear/waste_reprocessor)Waste Reprocessor$(/l) and $(l:drone_systems/drone_assembler)Drone Assembler$(/l). Each has $(l)3 addon slots$() on a tab on the right edge of its GUI.
pages.title: In machines

pages.text: A slot holds a stack of one addon type, and pipes and hoppers never reach them. The Water Pump has no GUI and takes none.$(br)$(li)$(l)Speed Addon$(): +50% speed and +80% FE/t each, max 4$(br)$(li)$(l)Efficiency Addon$(): -20% FE per operation each, max 3

$(li)$(l)Battery Addon$(): +100% energy buffer each, max 4$(br)They stack: 4 Speed Addons make a machine $(l)3 times as fast$() for about 40% more FE per operation, and two Efficiency Addons more than win that back. A faster machine also takes proportionally more FE per tick from its cables.
